subject: HelixBank pre-audit intake: ISO & FedRAMP evidence timeline and owners
messages:
From: Sam Chen <sam.chen@helixbank.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@compliance-partners.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: HelixBank pre-audit intake: ISO/FedRAMP readiness and evidence timeline

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the call yesterday. HelixBank is kicking off a pre-audit intake to validate Redwood's readiness for two concurrent tracks: ISO 27001 certification (internal audit planned Q3) and a FedRAMP pre-assessment to understand gaps for a potential Moderate authorization.

Two asks to get started:
- Can you share a short list of evidence artifacts and an owner for each (SOC 2 evidence, network diagrams, encryption configs, personnel training records, KMS logs, retention policy, change-control evidence)?
- We have a preferred sampling window in mid-July. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide time-bound evidence (logs/config snapshots) for that window or need alternative sampling?

I copied our auditor (Lena Ortiz) who will lead the pre-assessment. Attached is a short intake form (helixbank_preaudit_request.pdf). Can we aim for a 30-minute intake call the week of June 7?

Appreciate a point person and rough timeline.

Best,
Sam Chen
Senior Procurement Manager, HelixBank
attachments: helixbank_preaudit_request.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Sam Chen <sam.chen@helixbank.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@compliance-partners.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 12:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: HelixBank pre-audit intake: ISO/FedRAMP readiness and evidence timeline

Sam / Lena — thanks for the clear ask and for looping us in. Happy to own the coordination from Redwood. Quick responses and proposed next steps below: 

Owners (proposed)
- Evidence inventory & SOC 2 artifacts: Marissa Cole (Compliance Program Manager)
- Network diagrams, architecture & KMS config: Mina Haddad (Security Ops)
- Contract/DPAs and retention policy: Neha Kapoor (Legal) — cc'd, will confirm availability

Sampling window
- We can produce most time-bound artifacts for a mid-July window. For some items (e.g., historic KMS access logs) we may need to run an extraction; propose the week of July 13-17 as the primary window and July 20-24 as a fallback.

Scope clarification needed
- Is HelixBank asking us to target FedRAMP Low or FedRAMP Moderate for the assessment? Moderate will change sample size and some control expectations (e.g., enhanced encryption at rest and logging granularity).

Proposed next steps
1) Schedule 30-minute intake (week of June 7) — I can share a short agenda.
2) Marissa to share a starter evidence matrix and attachment (see attached evidence_mapping_v1.xlsx).
3) We’ll confirm owners and mark items that require extracts or system snapshots.

I’ll schedule the intake once Lena / Sam confirm availability.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
phone: +1-415-555-0123
attachments: evidence_mapping_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Sam Chen <sam.chen@helixbank.com>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@compliance-partners.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixBank pre-audit intake: ISO/FedRAMP readiness and evidence timeline

Thanks — pulling initial inventory together. High-level evidence buckets we will prepare and estimated lead times below (will populate the matrix and mark owners):

1) Organizational & policy artifacts (retention, access control policy, change management, incident response): owner Neha / Marissa — available in 3 business days.

2) Personnel & training records (onboarding, security training attestation): owner Marissa — 5 business days to produce sampled records and redaction.

3) System architecture & network diagrams (VPC diagrams, subnet ACLs, publicly accessible endpoints): owner Mina — diagram and narrative in 4 business days; configuration snapshots may take longer depending on region-specific exports.

4) Logging & monitoring evidence (cloud audit logs, alerting runbooks, SOC playbooks): owner Mina — can provide example alerts and log extracts for the proposed July window; extraction scheduling required (estimate 7 business days for full extracts).

5) Cryptography & key management (KMS policies, rotation logs, access lists): owner Mina — need to confirm retention of historical rotation events; if older than retention window we will provide available artifacts and a signed attestation.

6) SOC 2-specific: control narratives, control owner attestations, latest SOC 2 report (if available): owner Marissa — SOC 2 report will be shared under NDA if requested.

Open questions for HelixBank / auditor:
- Confirm FedRAMP target baseline (Low vs Moderate).
- Do you require on-demand snapshots of our KMS keys and audit logs, or are sampled extracts acceptable?
- Any custom evidence requirements beyond SIG/CAIQ mappings?

Attachments: I’ve uploaded an editable evidence_inventory_template.csv and pre-filled rows in evidence_mapping_v1.xlsx. Please review and flag any additional artifacts.

I suggest we lock owners and tasks on the intake call; we’ll also add a short JIRA board to track evidence requests.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: evidence_inventory_template.csv (text/csv)

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: HelixBank pre-audit intake: ISO/FedRAMP readiness and evidence timeline

Thanks — quick operational note from SecOps.

- Confirmed: July 13-17 works for log sampling in US regions (we’ll reserve a 48-hour extraction window).
- KMS rotation history: we retain rotation metadata for 18 months; full access logs exist but need uplift for redaction and export (estimate 5 business days once requested).
- Network diagrams: will include overlay showing control-plane endpoints and our default egress policy.

Proposed intake agenda (30 min):
1) Confirm scope: ISO vs FedRAMP baseline (5 min)
2) Review evidence matrix & owners (10 min)
3) Decide sampling windows & extraction responsibilities (10 min)
4) Actions & timeline (5 min)

I’ll be on the call with the SecOps engineer who helps with extracts. Jana (secops-engineer@redwood.com) will join to confirm the extraction plan.

If HelixBank/Lena confirm June 9 or June 10 at 10:00am PT I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short dial-in agenda.
